question: What was the name of the ICC Champions Trophy tournament before it was renamed in 2002?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**ICC KnockOut Trophy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Champions Trophy** tournament, organized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**, began in **1998** in **Bangladesh** as the **ICC KnockOut Trophy**.
 
• **South Africa** won the inaugural Champions Trophy by defeating the **West Indies** in the final.
 
• Early editions of the Champions Trophy were held in **ICC Associate member nations** to promote the sport in those regions. For example, **Kenya** hosted the tournament in **2000**.
 
• From the **2002 edition**, the tournament was renamed as the **Champions Trophy**, also referred to as the **Mini World Cup**, due to a change in format.
 
• Since the **2009 edition**, only the **top eight ODI teams**, based on ICC rankings at a pre-decided qualification cutoff date, compete in the Champions Trophy.
